description: Prices a print run of a stapled 8.5 x 11 in magazine on 100 lb satin paper: Mixam's print price for that page count and quantity (quoted from Mixam's own calculator, date included), ground shipping to one US address, sales tax, our margin, card fees, the total and the price per copy. With mail_to_readers it adds, per reader, First-Class Mail postage for a flat at the issue's weight, an envelope and handling (copies come to us and we mail each one). Example: {"pages":28,"copies":10}; {"pages":24,"copies":40,"mail_to_readers":true}.

mail_to_readers.description: true = we mail one copy to each reader on a list the writer uploads (copies = number of readers)

pages.description: Page count including covers, a multiple of 4 (lay_out_issue gives an estimate; the issue page shows the exact count)

name: price_print_run
title: Price printed copies of an issue: print, shipping, tax and the per-copy cost
